lessons.keep: Show the difficulty before the achievement, using real human reactions.
lessons.avoid: Avoid presenting a selective archival montage as complete historical proof.
lessons.open: Historical chronology, interview accuracy, source rights, disclaimer text and audio delivery remain unverified.
try: Build a Tin customer story around one failed campaign, the specific correction and a dated outcome.
Use repeated framing to bookend a short company story, with clear dates on evidence clips.

comparison.story: Introduce a retrospective voice and subject. → Establish ambition and skepticism. → Present setbacks and interruption. → Give the setbacks personal weight. → Show persistence reaching an achievement. → Broaden the story toward future ambition. → Close with a human interview coda.
